title: FoundryTicket
description: Normalized work request artifact produced by shape.intake. Published to run:artifacts/{visit_id}/ticket.json.

raw_input.description: Verbatim or faithful capture of user-supplied input.

normalized_translation.description: Optional normalized summary; examination may fill when intake only captured verbatim input.

source_type.description: How the work request was supplied.

source_ref.description: File path, URL, or ticket filename when applicable; otherwise null.

issue_key.description: External issue key when applicable; null in v1 (Jira deferred).
